description: Forge steps F3 and F5 together: a level that can be shared is made in Forge from the Blank Room and played. The Blank Room (dev-mods/blank_room: an original one-room level with eight starts and no objects) is staged as a mod. One ordinary client launch opens its placements through --debug-forge-level, adds a player start 40 units in front of the first one, makes a weapon place from nothing 160 units in front of it (an empty level has no pickup to copy), gives that place the catalog weapon base:dragon through --debug-forge-level-weapon, makes an ammo crate from nothing 280 units in front, and saves the result as the mod level 'Forge_Room'. The same launch then starts an offline Combat Simulator match on mod:arena_forge_room with three simulants. What this proves: the level document's new objects (the 37 field rows of a weapon place and the 68 of an ammo crate, with the values every such object of the base arenas shares) compile in the game as two setup records; the three pads Forge added, which name no room as base pads do, are each found inside the room's box from rooms.json (pads=11, none without a room); the level graph keeps a trigger volume node for each of the eleven bounds rows; the game makes the pinned weapon pickup at command 0; and the player spawns and stays live. What it does not prove: that the pickup and the crate are drawn where they were put or can be collected (nothing here looks at the world or walks to them). The saved level holds only the Blank Room's own data plus two model ids of the game's, so it is a level that can be shared.

input_sequence.comment: Pause the script until the ordinary Combat Simulator player is continuously spawned, live, controllable and walking on the level made from the Blank Room. The level was made by the first CLI fast paths, before the room launch flags.
Eight seconds on the level (the screenshot is taken at three), then a scripted exit.

required_lines: FORGE\.LEVEL\.OPEN: arena=mod_blank_room:arena_blank_room pads=8 spawns=8 objects=0 field_rows=0 archive='.*blank_room\.pdarena' scenario='dependencies/assets/scenarios/scenario_blank_room\.pdscenario'
FORGE\.LEVEL\.EDIT: added spawn spawn_0008 at \(810, 50, 0\), in front of spawn_0000 on pad_0000
FORGE\.LEVEL\.EDIT: made weapon place setup_0000 at \(690, 50, 0\): the level had no weapon pickup to copy
FORGE\.LEVEL\.EDIT: setup_0000 now gives base:dragon \(model base:model_[a-z0-9_]+, size [1-9]\d*\)
FORGE\.LEVEL\.EDIT: made ammo crate setup_0001 at \(570, 50, 0\): the level had none to leave out
FORGE\.LEVEL\.EDIT: the level now has pads=11 spawns=9 objects=2
FORGE\.LEVEL\.SAVE\.OK: template=mod_blank_room:arena_blank_room catalog=mod:arena_forge_room changed_members=6 restart_count=\d+ archive='.*arena_forge_room\.pdarena' own_template=0
SCENARIO\.GRAPH: trigger volume nodes '[^']*arena_forge_room[^']*' nodes=11 rows=11
SCENARIO\.SOURCE: compiled setup\.fields\.json '[^']*arena_forge_room[^']*'.* as 2 setup records, 9 spawns,
SETUP: fixed weapon pickup cmd=0 weapon=[1-9]\d* model=[1-9]\d* prop=1
